    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.122.1...0.122.2">0.122.2</a> (2026-08-28)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>

<li><strong>auth:</strong> support configurable Cloud auth header name (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10375" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10375/hovercard">#10375</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/997cb56535dd5ba5ab602adbd8aaca266ac9141e">997cb56</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add Codex Security SDK provider (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/10467" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/10467/hovercard">#10467</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/df8a5ab89807f9ec2c3c5bb9fb6a80dce630cc1f">df8a5ab</a>)</li>
</ul></content>
